'''Reeho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around the end of the Cold War, Agent Reeho was assigned to investigate the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]]&mdash;a competition sponsored by the [[Chevin Conglomerate]] to recover a series of rare and unique items&mdash;and to discover the Conglomerate's purpose for the event.<ref name="The Grand Acquisitions Race" />

Reeho enlisted the help of a Republic-allied operative to investigate the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] and recover the items, and through surveillance the two learned that the Chevin were gathering the items as an offering for a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] fleet that was returning to known space. In return for the operative's help, Reeho gave the individual help recovering several of the items, and convinced the operative to turn the items over to the Republic instead of the Chevin.<ref name="The Grand Acquisitions Race" />
